title: Austin Recycling Games & Initiatives Unveiled
summary:
*   City Council members attended a press conference on the "Austin Recycles Games" and new city-wide recycling initiatives.
*   The event focused on promoting community engagement in Austin's recycling efforts.
*   This was an informational gathering, and no official council action, votes, or policy decisions were made during the session.
